message: 仲間にして欲しそうに見ている

name: Synn
message: 「My wish is...」
May the Holy Night Festival be a dazzling, wonderful success--
In the middle of Student Council duties, we found ourselves with a brief stretch of free time. A spare moment too short to go out and have fun, yet too long to just take a quick break.
As Student Council President and Vice President, Misa and I came to Asukai Shrine to offer our prayers.

name: Misa
message: 「*Glance*」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph... He's still making his wish, isn't he.」

name: Misa
message: 「I won't lose! It's a contest to see who can make more wishes!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, don't you think the gods won't grant them if you wish for too many things?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. The god of Asukai Shrine isn't nearly that stingy.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's really true...」

name: Misa
message: 「Ever since I was little, I've been making my wishes right here...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's one generous god, granting so many wishes for you.」

name: Misa
message: 「I never said that, did I?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Because just now, you--」

name: Misa
message: 「Relying on the gods to just hand you whatever you want is far too selfish.」

name: Misa
message: 「Making a wish here is the spark--it means working hard on your own so you can turn whatever dream you have at the time into reality.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph! You were just thinking I've been an argumentative girl ever since I was a kid, weren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I was thinking I'd like to follow your example.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to redo my wish.」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to give my all to our Student Council duties to make the Holy Night Festival a success.」

name: Synn
message: 「But lately, Demons have been showing up all over, so we've barely had the chance to focus on that.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I was having the selfish thought of wanting the gods to take care of at least one of them for us.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though both the Holy Night Festival and the Demon situation are things we have to see through ourselves.」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I am thoroughly impressed!」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyah!? Y-You startled me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, Shio, don't sneak up behind me like that.」

name: Shio
message: 「My humblest apologies. Imitating the finest expert in Ryuusei Town, Jiiya-dono, I was attempting a covert approach.」

name: Shio
message: 「However...!」

name: Shio
message: 「Admiring Jiiya-dono's mind, technique, and physique, I had written his name on an eraser and was trying to use it all up, yet as of today, I shall cease!」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-What kind of charm is that?」

name: Shio
message: 「Those who refuse to take a single step forward shall never see their wishes fulfilled.」

name: Shio
message: 「Furthermore, every night I have been writing the name of my esteemed Jiiya-dono two hundred times in green ink inside a notebook, but--」

name: Paqy
message: 「S-Scary. This girl is scary...」

name: Shio
message: 「That one, I shall continue.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're gonna keep doing it?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister, I shall train steadily and show you that I can surpass Jiiya-dono!」

name: Misa
message: 「Do your best, Shio. Sakura-kun, let's cheer her on too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Shio
message: 「Also, while we're at it, leave the extermination of monsters to your younger sister, Shio Asukai.」

name: Paqy
message: 「"While we're at it"?! ...Man, the great me is already tired of playing the straight man.」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, this girl has no idea how worried I get, always doing such dangerous things...」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen carefully, Shio? Pay close attention. We'll be the ones to defeat the demons--」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right! Could you let us help out with your demon hunting too, Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hold on, Sakura-kun, what are you saying--」

name: Misa
message: 「R-Right, Shio. For generations, the Asukai family has fought mortal battles against monsters.」

name: Misa
message: 「You've held out all on your own until now. But lately, the number of Demons has been increasing, hasn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Fighting alongside us isn't cowardly, nor will it tarnish the pride of the Asukai family.」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Sister... To think you were so deeply concerned for my well-being...」

name: Shio
message: 「Hahaha! Very well, then. If you insist so strongly, I shall allow you to accompany me on my monster-slaying.」
Shio-chan joined the party.

name: Shio
message: 「However, I must ask that you take every precaution not to become a hindrance to me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Pfft. Look at Shio getting all carried away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let her have it, that's just Shio-chan's way of showing she's happy. Thanks to this, we'll be able to keep an eye on her so she doesn't do anything reckless from now on.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yeah, I feel so much more at ease now.」

name: Shio
message: 「B-By the way, Sister.」

name: Misa
message: 「What is it?」

name: Shio
message: 「Forget the pride of the Asukai family--would you happen to know the secret to Jiiya-dono's strength, or perhaps the ABCs of battle tactics?」

name: Misa
message: 「R-Right after you declared you'd put in the effort yourself, Shio...」
